purpose: Integrate CAAM (coding_agent_account_manager) as AIWorks' account-selection and isolated-launch adapter with durable per-run account binding while AIWorks retains full scheduling and recovery ownership.

authorization.grantedBy: owner (netbka), delegated to the owner's main session
authorization.text: On 2026-10-13 the owner directed the integration of CAAM (v0.1.23) as AIWorks' account-selection and isolated-launch adapter under delivery program netbka/aiworks#14 and issue netbka/aiworks#9. AIWorks retains exclusive ownership of scheduling, retries, task recovery and independent verification. Workers are never wrapped with failover-driven 'caam run'. Execution is headless. Consumer AGY rotation is excluded. Each operation durably binds its account identity. Provider order Claude, then Codex.

constraints: Program netbka/aiworks#14: deliver docs/design/ACCOUNT_ADAPTER_CAAM.md through supervisor campaigns. Change only the files your task names. Other campaigns change other files at the same time: never edit their files, other agents' branches or worktrees, or campaigns/*.json.

Your assigned worktree is the only place you change files. Never touch D:/Git/aiworks/.local (live runtime, supervisor data directory, governance checkout, other worktrees) or the main checkout, and never start, stop or restart the supervisor, its scheduled tasks or the dashboard.

No production access, deployment, GitHub Actions changes, paid services, Telegram or other provider API calls, or new recurring spend. Never read .env contents, credentials or secret files. Read Engineering Platform only with read-only gh commands; never write the governance checkout or open changes in another repository: EP-side changes are proposed as text.
Follow AGENTS.md: run npm ci once in your worktree, then npm run check after changes. Report exact commands and pass/fail tallies.

Never weaken an assertion, delete or skip a test, or broaden a timeout to make the gate pass. Tests make no model, network or GitHub calls: synthetic executables and disposable git repositories, as tests/supervisor/helpers.mjs does.
Keep AW-001 to AW-008 as written. Do not enable a power whose decision is still open: design it, or build it switched off, and name the decision it waits for.

Label every claim about the running system observed, verified, planned or unknown (AGENTS.md evidence rule); merged is not deployed. Do not comment on GitHub, merge, close issues or change labels: the supervisor publishes your verified commit. Write "Refs #9", never "Closes".
Write for the owner first: plain English, short sentences, the outcome before the mechanism. Link Engineering Platform policies instead of copying them.

Read GitHub with REST only (gh api repos/netbka/aiworks/issues/<n> --jq .body, .../comments, gh api repos/netbka/aiworks/pulls/<n>), never gh issue view or gh pr view: the account GraphQL quota is shared (#16, #21).

Repository CI runs npm ci and npm run check on ubuntu-latest (.github/workflows/check.yml). Every test you add or change must pass there and on Windows: guard platform-specific behaviour with a skip that names the reason, without weakening what it checks on Windows (#42). Copy the node:test summary lines (# tests, # pass, # fail, # skipped) verbatim from the output; never retype a tally (#43).

tasks.title: Add durable account identity to operations table in store.mjs
tasks.outcome: Every operation row durably records its selected account identity, and existing databases upgrade without error.
tasks.goal: Update src/supervisor/store.mjs to add the account_identity column to the operations table DDL and add an automatic additive migration in the Store constructor using PRAGMA table_info(operations). Update recordOperation to accept and persist account_identity. Add unit test assertions in tests/supervisor/store.test.mjs verifying that older stores without the column migrate cleanly, that legacy rows return null, and that new recorded operations durably persist and read back account_identity across store close and reopen.
constraints: Change only src/supervisor/store.mjs and tests/supervisor/store.test.mjs. Keep WAL mode and existing fencing intact. STORE_VERSION remains unchanged as this is an additive backward-compatible column migration.
acceptance: operations table schema includes account_identity TEXT.
Store constructor executes ALTER TABLE operations ADD COLUMN account_identity TEXT when the column is absent on non-read-only open.
Legacy rows return account_identity as null without errors.
recordOperation persists account_identity and retrieve returns the identical string.
npm run check passes.

tasks.title: Implement CAAM profile discovery and robot CLI adapter
tasks.outcome: AIWorks discovers available provider accounts, credential health, tiers and cooldowns through CAAM robot mode.
tasks.goal: Create src/supervisor/adapters/caam.mjs implementing read-only profile discovery through CAAM CLI robot mode (caam robot status <provider>). Map executor kinds (claude-cli -> claude, codex-cli -> codex). Parse JSON outputs into validated profile descriptors: name, active, healthy, cooldown active and until, plan type, and token expiration. Add tests in tests/supervisor/caam-adapter.test.mjs verifying parsing of healthy profiles, cooling down profiles, expired sessions, and missing/error responses with synthetic mock CLIs.
constraints: Change only src/supervisor/adapters/caam.mjs and tests/supervisor/caam-adapter.test.mjs. Make no live network or provider calls in tests. Never store or log secret tokens.
acceptance: caamRobotStatus parses robot JSON output into structured profile records.
Profiles in cooldown or critical health are accurately flagged.
Consumer AGY rotation is explicitly excluded with an informative error.
Unit tests verify handling of valid output, invalid JSON, CLI errors, and missing CAAM executable.
npm run check passes.

tasks.title: Dynamic account selection and atomic reservation in accounts.mjs and controller.mjs
tasks.outcome: AIWorks selects eligible accounts round-robin, reserves them atomically per operation, and pauses cleanly when all accounts wait.
tasks.goal: Refactor src/supervisor/accounts.mjs and src/supervisor/controller.mjs to support multi-account selection. Before dispatching a task, query eligible profiles for the chosen executor, skipping profiles that have active rows in provider_waits or are in CAAM cooldown. Select among eligible profiles using round-robin / least-recently-used. Bind the chosen profile to the operation inside the dispatch transaction. If all profiles are in cooldown, calculate the earliest reset time and set a provider-cooldown wait without burning retries.
constraints: Change only src/supervisor/accounts.mjs, src/supervisor/controller.mjs and tests/supervisor/provider-accounts.test.mjs. Profile reservation must commit inside the BEGIN IMMEDIATE dispatch transaction. Do not wrap workers with caam run.
acceptance: Selection rotates among eligible healthy profiles across consecutive dispatches.
A profile with an active wait or cooldown is skipped.
When all profiles wait, the campaign waits for the earliest reset and no operation is recorded.
Reservation commits in the same transaction as recordOperation.
npm run check passes.

tasks.title: Headless shallow profile environment launching in executors.mjs
tasks.outcome: Workers launch headlessly in isolated shallow profile environments while preserving AIWorks security controls.
tasks.goal: Update src/supervisor/adapters/executors.mjs and src/supervisor/adapters/caam.mjs to configure the worker execution environment using CAAM shallow profile directories. Set HOME and USERPROFILE to the profile shallow home, set CODEX_HOME for Codex, and inject CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AGENT_VIEW=1, CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BACKGROUND_TASKS=1, CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY=1 for Claude. Ensure all existing security flags (--setting-sources "", --strict-mcp-config, --disable apps, --sandbox) remain strictly enforced and uncompromised. Verify execution through runner.mjs and windows-process.ps1.
constraints: Change only src/supervisor/adapters/executors.mjs, src/supervisor/adapters/caam.mjs, and tests/supervisor/executors.test.mjs. Keep Windows Job Object containment intact. Do not use an interactive PTY.
acceptance: invocation.env contains isolated HOME and USERPROFILE pointing to shallow profile.
CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AGENT_VIEW=1 is present for Claude invocations.
Security isolation flags (--setting-sources "", --strict-mcp-config, --disable apps) remain strictly enforced.
Prompt input, stdout capture, and process exit codes work reliably under Job Object containment.
npm run check passes.

tasks.title: Per-profile cooldown attribution, capacity throttling and crash recovery
tasks.outcome: Quota and auth outcomes cool down only the failing profile, and supervisor crash recovery preserves account binding.
tasks.goal: Update outcome classification and reaping in src/supervisor/controller.mjs and accounts.mjs so that quota, auth, and unavailable outcomes are recorded in provider_waits keyed by the operation's exact account_identity. A quota outcome halves concurrency for that specific profile in the capacity table, leaving sibling profiles active. On supervisor restart, open operations recover their durable account_identity from the operations table without duplicate PRs or commits. A successful run clears the wait for that specific profile.
constraints: Change only src/supervisor/accounts.mjs, src/supervisor/controller.mjs and tests/supervisor/provider-accounts.test.mjs. Keep existing refund rules and zero-work refusal logic intact.
acceptance: Quota failure on profile A records a wait for profile A only; profile B remains available.
Concurrency throttling adjusts capacity for profile A only.
Supervisor restart reloads in-flight operations with exact account_identity.
Successful result clears the wait for that specific profile.
npm run check passes.

tasks.title: Comprehensive multi-account integration tests and rollback toggle
tasks.outcome: Full validation suite verifies concurrent isolation, crash recovery and clean rollback via config toggle.
tasks.goal: Add tests/supervisor/caam-integration.test.mjs covering the full validation matrix: concurrent multi-account isolation, round-robin rotation, quota failover without duplicate work, supervisor crash/restart recovery, secret non-leakage, and the rollback toggle. When config.json has caam.enabled = false, verify that the supervisor seamlessly falls back to legacy single-account behavior without errors. Update docs/SUPERVISOR.md and docs/STATUS.md describing the CAAM adapter and configuration.
constraints: Change tests/supervisor/caam-integration.test.mjs, docs/SUPERVISOR.md, and docs/STATUS.md. All tests use synthetic mock CLIs with zero external network or model calls. Full test suite must pass on Windows and Linux.
acceptance: Integration tests prove two accounts run concurrently with distinct isolated environments.
Simulated quota on profile A causes next task to dispatch to profile B without duplicate PRs or commits.
Regex scan confirms zero secret tokens in database, run dirs, or logs.
Setting caam.enabled = false falls back cleanly to legacy single-account behavior.
npm run check passes with 0 failures.
